Loyalty update: the problem isn't enrollment, it's engagement — members who actually redeem a point order ~2x more and spend 85%+ more than similar non-members, while the 83% who sign up and never redeem spend far less than everyone else.

For the loyalty members who do engage, rewards are generous: they've redeemed €177.8k in points against €434k of their own revenue — a 41% effective discount rate, well above the 19.4% blended number we shared last week.

Checked for loyalty program abuse and found none: no one redeems within 30 days of signing up, and about 30% of engaged members go quiet after their first reward regardless of how fast they redeemed — that's normal churn, not gaming.
